preconditions.expression: all(t.isdigit() for t in stdin.splitlines()[0].split()) and 1 <= int(stdin.splitlines()[0].split()[0]) <= 100
preconditions.description: The first line of stdin contains an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 100) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 1 and line.split()[0].isdigit() and 1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 10**12 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each subsequent line contains a single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^12) representing a test case.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().splitlines() == [str(k) for k in [min_k(n) for n in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]]]
postconditions.description: For each test case n, stdout contains a line with the minimum k such that n can be represented as the sum of k distinct powerful numbers, or -1 if no such k exists.

postconditions.expression: all(k == -1 or (k >= 1 and all(1 <= sum(powerful_set) == n and len(powerful_set) == k and all(p != q for p in powerful_set for q in powerful_set if p != q) for powerful_set in possible_sets(n, k))) for n, k in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]], [int(line) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()]))
postconditions.description: If k is not -1, there exists at least one set of k distinct powerful numbers summing to n. If k is -1, no such set exists.

postconditions.expression: all(k == 1 or (k == -1 or any(sum(powerful_set) == n and len(powerful_set) == k and all(p != q for p in powerful_set for q in powerful_set if p != q) for powerful_set in possible_sets(n, k))) for n, k in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]], [int(line) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()]))
postconditions.description: If k is 1, n itself must be a powerful number. Otherwise, k is the smallest integer for which such a set exists.
